data.summary:
Secure a challenging role in a reputed organization to level up my knowledge and skillset. Explore opportunities in a customer-based environment to provide excellent services which Satisfies requirement and would be helpful for the organization.
Highly Skilled Power Platform Developer with 5.5 years of experience in developing and implementing custom applications using Microsoft Power Platform. As a forward-thinking Power Platform Developer, I specialize in utilizing Power Automate to streamline business processes through powerful automation and seamless workflow integration. With expertise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, I enhance application development by incorporating intelligent, context-aware features to improve user interactions. Additionally, I integrate AI Hub capabilities to embed AI models and automation into applications, unlocking new levels of productivity and insight. Proficient in low-code/no-code development, automation, and data visualization to drive efficiency and insights. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, SharePoint Online, Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse.

raw_sections.skills:
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents), Power Pages
Databases: Microsoft Dataverse, SharePoint Lists & Libraries, MS Excel
Programming Languages: Power Fx, JavaScript, HTML, CSS

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (5.5+ years)
3.4 years with Tata Consultancy Services, Pune
Designation: Senior System Engineer (Date of Joining: 29 th July 2019— 19 th Nov 2022)
Role: SharePoint Developer Client: Metso Outotec Team Size: 11
Activities Performed:
Create Master Pages, branding site layouts and master pages, Web Parts, OOTB Features, Lists, Custom Solutions.
Working on Changes with respect to the information provided for a SharePoint site.
Reach out and obtain further details from customers via Teams call, chat, or email.
Workflow, SharePoint Search, managing user permissions list and group level Customizing SharePoint sites, managing portal content, and maintaining sites.
Create the flow to send the emails on record creation or update, Send the reminder emails.
Create the approval flows to automate the app and escalation flows.
Currently working with Infosys, Pune
Designation: Senior Associate Consultant (Date of Joining: 21/11/2022 — Present)
Role: Power Platform Developer
Client: John Deere India Private Limited, NextEra Energy, Johnson Controls International Ltd, Hallmark Global Technologies Ltd, Florida Power & Light Company
Team Size: 6-8
Activities Performed:
Microsoft Power Automate (Flow)
Flows to send the attachment over the emails and convert the document in pdf. Upload the documents and images on SharePoint and 0neDrive.
Call the HTTP connector API using. Create the AI models. Adding a file content to build custom email template.
Worked on twitter flow with SharePoint, to tweet the post and save the tweet.
Create the business processes and update SharePoint secondary list data.
Manage employees leave records using flow with app.
Manage PowerApps, Power Automate permissions using flow.
Manage License Assignments process along with approval using flow.
Export & import PowerBI reports, datasets, dashboards etc using flow.
Get Environment Capacity and send alert when specific threshold value is met.
Microsoft Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents)
Working on Creation of Support Agent for organization. Creations of topics, actions as per requirement.
Integrations with Microsoft teams, SharePoint SPFx component along with implementation of single sign on for both of them.
Granting permissions to PowerApps and Power Automate to end user using MS flow.
Add additional owner to PowerApps and Power Automate to end user using MS flow.
Create ServiceNow ticket when support agent is not able to satisfy user query.
Integrated AI Builder into Power Automate flow to automatically extract short description and category selection at the time of ticket creation.
Integrated Copilot Studio to assist in dynamic workflow creation, improving efficiency for the development team and reducing manual code entry.
Integrated Adaptive cards to ask information from the end user.
Microsoft PowerApps
Worked on the Power Apps, formula expressions, Converts the InfoPath forms functionality into PowerApps.
Creates the Canvas, Model- Driven Apps and Power Pages.
Creates the Apps using Dataverse, EXCEL, SharePoint, SQL server, My SQL and Azure Blog Storage databases.
Embed the PowerBI reports and worked with charts.
Embed the PowerApps in SharePoint.
Having experience on customizing apps
Microsoft Power Pages
Having experience on Power pages to create the sites and integrate the data with Dataverse.
Configure user authentication on the power pages. And having hands on web templates and customize the templates. Worked with Liquid to add the dynamic content on the pages.
Delivered user training and documentation to ensure smooth adoption and usability of the developed solutions.
Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with tight deadlines.
